name: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering
description: A comprehensive undergraduate programme covering algorithms, data structures, programming (C, C++, Java, Python), databases, operating systems, computer networks, software engineering, and web technologies. Students undertake a major project in the final year and a mandatory summer internship. Graduates are prepared for careers in software development, system administration, and IT consulting.
eligibility: 10+2 with PCM, valid JEE Main score
search_text: B.Tech Computer Science Engineering, 4 years, JEE Main, 60 seats, ₹1.5 lakh/year. Covers programming, databases, networks, software engineering. Career in software development, IT consulting.

name: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering with AI & ML
description: A specialised UG programme focused on artificial intelligence and machine learning. In addition to core CSE topics, students learn Python for data science, supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and big data tools. The curriculum includes a year‑long AI project and industry mentorship. Graduates are sought after for AI engineer, data scientist, and research roles.
eligibility: 10+2 with PCM, valid JEE Main score
search_text: B.Tech CSE with AI & ML, 4 years, JEE Main, 40 seats, ₹1.7 lakh/year. Focus on AI, ML, deep learning, NLP, big data. Careers as AI engineer, data scientist.

name: Diploma in Computer Science Engineering
description: A practical diploma programme that builds foundational skills in computer hardware, programming, networking, and database management. Students gain hands‑on experience through lab work and industry visits. Graduates can work as junior programmers, network technicians, or pursue lateral entry into B.Tech.
eligibility: 10+2 pass (Science or Commerce)
search_text: Diploma in CSE, 3 years, 30 seats, ₹80k/year. Hands-on programming, networking, database. Careers as junior programmer, technician.

name: Bachelor in Computer Applications (BCA)
description: An application‑oriented UG programme covering programming, web development, database management, and software engineering. Students work on live projects and gain exposure to modern development tools. BCA graduates are well‑suited for roles in IT services, web development, and system administration.
eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics or Computer Science
search_text: BCA, 3 years, 45 seats, ₹1 lakh/year. Programming, web development, database. Careers in IT services, web dev.

name: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
description: A postgraduate programme that deepens knowledge in advanced algorithms, software architecture, cloud computing, and big data. Includes a dissertation and industry internship. MCA graduates are prepared for senior developer, system architect, and project manager roles.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level
search_text: MCA, 2 years, 30 seats, ₹1.2 lakh/year. Advanced algorithms, cloud computing, big data. Careers as senior developer, architect.

name: M.Sc. in Computer Science (Data Science)
description: A research‑oriented PG programme specialising in data science. Covers statistical methods, machine learning, data visualisation, and big data analytics. Students complete a research project and publish a paper. Ideal for careers in data analytics, business intelligence, and PhD pursuits.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in CS/IT/Mathematics with minimum 55%
search_text: M.Sc CS Data Science, 2 years, 25 seats, ₹1 lakh/year. Stats, ML, data viz, big data. Careers in data analytics, BI.

name: M.Tech in Cyber Forensics
description: A specialised programme focused on digital forensics, incident response, and cybercrime investigation. Students learn forensic tools, encryption, malware analysis, and legal aspects. Graduates work as forensic analysts, security consultants, or in law enforcement agencies.
eligibility: B.Tech/BE in CSE/IT/ECE or M.Sc with GATE/entrance
search_text: M.Tech Cyber Forensics, 2 years, 18 seats, ₹1.4 lakh/year. Digital forensics, malware, encryption. Careers as forensic analyst, security consultant.

name: M.Tech in Cyber Forensics and Information Security
description: An integrated programme covering both cyber forensics and information security. Students study network security, cryptography, risk management, and digital evidence collection. The curriculum includes a capstone project with industry partners. Prepares for roles in cybersecurity management and consulting.
eligibility: B.Tech/BE in CSE/IT/ECE or M.Sc with GATE/entrance
search_text: M.Tech Cyber Forensics & Information Security, 2 years, 18 seats, ₹1.5 lakh/year. Network security, cryptography, forensics. Careers in cybersecurity management.

name: M.Tech in Electronics Design and Technology
description: A PG programme emphasising analog/digital circuit design, VLSI, embedded systems, and signal processing. Students work on hardware design projects and gain proficiency in EDA tools. Graduates are recruited in semiconductor, consumer electronics, and automotive industries.
eligibility: B.Tech/BE in ECE/EEE or related, GATE/entrance
search_text: M.Tech Electronics Design, 2 years, 20 seats, ₹1.3 lakh/year. Circuit design, VLSI, embedded. Careers in semiconductor, automotive.

name: M.Tech in Embedded Systems
description: A specialised programme in embedded hardware and software design. Covers microcontrollers, RTOS, FPGA, IoT protocols, and low‑power design. Students build prototypes using ARM and Arduino platforms. Graduates work in automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics companies.
eligibility: B.Tech/BE in ECE/EEE/CSE, GATE/entrance
search_text: M.Tech Embedded Systems, 2 years, 20 seats, ₹1.35 lakh/year. Microcontrollers, RTOS, FPGA, IoT. Careers in automotive, aerospace.

name: M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
description: Advanced PG programme covering deep learning, reinforcement learning, generative models, and AI ethics. Students work on industry‑sponsored projects and publish research. Graduates are in high demand as AI researchers, data scientists, and ML engineers.
eligibility: B.Tech/BE in CSE/IT/ECE or M.Sc with GATE/entrance
search_text: M.Tech AI & ML, 2 years, 20 seats, ₹1.6 lakh/year. Deep learning, reinforcement learning, generative models. Careers as AI researcher, data scientist.

name: M.Tech in Automotive Electronics
description: A niche programme combining electronics with automotive engineering. Topics include ECUs, CAN/LIN protocols, sensor fusion, and autonomous driving systems. Students work on projects with automotive OEMs. Graduates find careers in automotive R&D and embedded systems for vehicles.
eligibility: B.Tech/BE in ECE/EEE/Mechanical with electronics background, GATE/entrance
search_text: M.Tech Automotive Electronics, 2 years, 15 seats, ₹1.5 lakh/year. ECUs, CAN/LIN, sensor fusion, autonomous driving. Careers in automotive R&D.

name: M.Tech in Data Engineering
description: A programme focused on big data pipelines, distributed systems, cloud data platforms, and data warehousing. Students learn Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and cloud services (AWS, GCP). Graduates are prepared for roles as data engineers, big data architects, and cloud consultants.
eligibility: B.Tech/BE in CSE/IT or M.Sc with strong programming background, GATE/entrance
search_text: M.Tech Data Engineering, 2 years, 20 seats, ₹1.4 lakh/year. Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, cloud. Careers as data engineer, big data architect.

name: M.Tech in IoT and Sensor Systems
description: A comprehensive programme covering IoT architecture, sensor networks, edge computing, and data analytics. Students design and deploy IoT solutions for smart cities, agriculture, and healthcare. The curriculum includes a live‑project with industry partners. Graduates work as IoT architects, embedded engineers, and solution developers.
eligibility: B.Tech/BE in ECE/EEE/CSE, GATE/entrance
search_text: M.Tech IoT & Sensor Systems, 2 years, 18 seats, ₹1.45 lakh/year. IoT architecture, sensor networks, edge computing. Careers as IoT architect, embedded engineer.

name: Ph.D. in Computer Science Engineering
description: Doctoral programme offering research in areas such as AI, machine learning, cybersecurity, data science, and theory of computation. Students work under faculty mentors, publish in top journals, and present at conferences. Candidates are expected to complete coursework and a dissertation. Graduates pursue academic, research, or industrial R&D careers.
eligibility: M.Tech/M.Sc in CS/IT/related with GATE/NET qualification
search_text: Ph.D. CSE, 3-5 years, 10 seats, ₹50k/year with stipend. Research in AI, ML, cybersecurity, data science. Careers in academia, R&D.

name: Ph.D. in Electronics Engineering
description: Research programme in areas like VLSI design, signal processing, communication systems, embedded systems, and IoT. Students work on cutting‑edge hardware/software co‑design and publish in IEEE/Elsevier journals. Graduates are recruited by universities, research labs, and semiconductor companies.
eligibility: M.Tech/M.E. in ECE/EEE/related with GATE/NET
search_text: Ph.D. Electronics, 3-5 years, 8 seats, ₹50k/year with stipend. Research in VLSI, signal processing, embedded, IoT. Careers in academia, semiconductor.

name: Ph.D. in Computer Science and Application
description: Research programme focusing on theoretical computer science, algorithms, database systems, and software engineering. Students contribute to foundational research and develop new methodologies. Graduates often join academic institutions or applied research labs.
eligibility: M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc in CS/IT with GATE/NET
search_text: Ph.D. CSA, 3-5 years, 8 seats, ₹50k/year with stipend. Research in algorithms, databases, software engineering. Careers in academia, research.

name: Post Graduate Diploma in Data Science
description: An intensive 1‑year programme covering Python, data wrangling, machine learning, deep learning, big data tools, and real‑world projects. Includes industry mentorship and a capstone project. Graduates are ready for data analyst, data scientist, and ML engineer roles.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation
search_text: PG Diploma Data Science, 1 year, 25 seats, ₹1.2 lakh total. Python, ML, deep learning, big data. Careers as data analyst, data scientist.

search_text: Certificate Data Science & ML Python, 3 months, 30 seats, ₹20k. Python, Pandas, ML, Scikit-learn. Ideal for professionals.

search_text: Certificate IoT, 3 months, 20 seats, ₹18k. Arduino, Raspberry Pi, sensors, cloud. Build IoT projects.

search_text: Certificate MySQL DBA, 2 months, 25 seats, ₹15k. Installation, tuning, backup, security. Careers as DBA.

search_text: Certificate VLSI Design, 4 months, 15 seats, ₹25k. Verilog, VHDL, FPGA, synthesis. Careers in semiconductor.

description: Practical course focusing on C programming for embedded systems – interfacing, timers, interrupts, and communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C). Uses ARM Cortex‑M boards. Ideal for embedded developers.
